notes: Billing document header, completing the sales cycle (order -> fulfillment -> invoice). Uses the FINANCE-side sheet as authoritative: the Sales-side 'Invoices' sheet was verified 1:1 identical on every shared column (Invoice_Number, Invoice_Date, Customer_ID, totals, Status, Currency -- 53/53 rows) and is already marked deprecated in legacy_to_sap_mapping.csv; its two extra columns are Fulfillment_ID (delivery document-flow link, see dropped_fields) and Payment_Terms (see ZTERM note below). BP NUMBERING: KUNAG uses the even-series staging key (Customer_ID x 2) established in customers_core.json, so billing documents resolve against the customer master. FKART='F2' is the standard delivered invoice type rather than a site-specific customizing value -- flag for confirmation alongside BSART='NB' on purchase orders if the target uses custom types.

fields.sap_description: Billing Document Number (staging key, matches VBRP lines)
Sold-to Party (staging key, even series Customer_ID x 2)
Reference Document (staging key of the source sales order, resolves against VBAK)
Reference Document Number (external legacy invoice number)
Net Value (header, tax-exclusive -- matches the sum of VBRP line net values)

dropped_fields.reason: tax is calculated per item via tax conditions (VBRP-MWSKZ / KONV), not stored on the header
derived -- net value plus tax conditions; the stored header value is NETWR (Subtotal)

AR clearing status is derived in SAP from incoming payment/clearing documents (ACDOCA/BSEG against the invoice), not carried as a flat field -- same treatment as Quantity_Received on PO schedule lines
same as Amount_Collected -- derived open-item status, not stored
VBRK has no due-date field -- it is derived at runtime from the billing date plus ZTERM payment terms; the terms themselves are the migration-relevant fact
structural in SAP -- billing/index/clearing status (RFBSK etc.) is set by posting and clearing events, not carried from source; same treatment as PO and sales-order Status
not present on this (Finance) sheet -- only on the deprecated Sales-side duplicate; VBRK-ZTERM should instead follow the customer master (KNVV-ZTERM) or the sales order (VBAK), both already mapped

not_migrated_fields.reason: captured automatically as the creating SAP user
